body.name: All-active Gaussian conditioning recursion
body.construction: For \(P\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\), use \(D_t^{\star}=\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\), compute \(\lambda_t(P)\) and \(\rho_t(P)\), and generate \(H_{it}=\lambda_t(P)^{\top}H_{i,D_t^{\star}}+\sqrt{\rho_t(P)}Z_{it}^{\circ}\) for every \(0\le t<T\). The strict inequalities defining \(\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\) make every inverse and square-root derivative ordinary on an open neighborhood. Iterating these operations gives \(\mathfrak R_T(P)\).
